1.title: Lesson Score: declare a constant value
1.description: Create a constant named `lessonScore` with the value 12, then log the value. Do not use var or let for this fixed score.
1.learningObjective: Use const for a score value that should not be reassigned.
instructions: Do not wrap the number in quotation marks.

workedExample.explanation: const creates a binding that cannot be reassigned. It is a good default for values that do not need a new assignment.

1.hint: A score stored as a number should not be written as the text string "12".
1.explanation: const creates a binding that cannot be reassigned. It is a good default for values that do not need a new assignment.
